provenance.provenance_evidence: The project-owned projection passage reproduces the retained calendar body hash exactly. Its artifact manifest records the bounded public-domain 1862 Pustet antecedent, the separate 1962 target, and every editorial transformation; neither witness is represented as owning the projected bytes. The 1962 reading was established on that edition's page images rather than its text layer, cross-read against the Benziger conformed printing. Differences from the antecedent: pointing was NOT collated: this comparison is word-level, because the witness reaches me as an optical text layer whose commas, colons and full stops are unreliable. Corroboration: Pustet Ratisbon 1862: Pustet Ratisbon 1862, printed p. 460 (nearest preceding printed-folio marker at text-layer line 64688); text-layer lines 64733-64741 (word-coverage of the 1962 body 0.867). Recorded limitation: Antecedent taken from the Tours Mame 1922 (editio quarta iuxta typicam Vaticanam). Word-coverage of the 1962 body at this locus 0.933, of the whole oration 0.938. Every 1862 and Mame reading in this lane rests on an optical text layer, not on a page image; 6 word(s) in this passage were damaged by the recogniser and were read against the 1962 wording rather than off the page - L55721 'Modesti' read as 'modesto'; L55721 'Crescentiz' read as 'crescentia'; L55723 'Ecclésice' read as 'ecclesie'; L55723 'queesumus,' read as 'quesumus'; L55729 'proficere:ut,' read as 'proficere'; L55730 'quecimque' read as 'quecumque'. What was NOT checked: the pointing, the ornamental initials, and the printed page of the 1862 beyond the nearest folio marker.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Da Ecclesiae tuae, quaesumus, Domine, sanctis Martyribus tuis Vito, Modesto
atque Crescentia intercedentibus, superbe non sapere, sed tibi placita
humilitate proficere: ut, prava despiciens, quaecumque recta sunt, libera
exerceat caritate. Per Dominum.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Sicut gloriam divinae potentiae munera pro Sanctis oblata testantur: sic
nobis effectum, Domine, tuae salvationis impendant. Per Dominum.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Repleti, Domine, benedictione solemni: quaesumus; ut, per intercessionem
sanctorum Martyrum tuorum Viti, Modesti et Crescentiae, medicina sacramenti
et corporibus nostris prosit et mentibus. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum
Christum, Filium tuum: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate.
